study type: Double-blinded, parallel, superiority, multicenter, randomized controlled clinical trial
outcome: Operative delivery (cesarean, forceps, or vacuum delivery)
Combined maternal mortality and serious morbidity
Combined perinatal mortality and serious morbidity
cohort: 254 nulliparous and parous women with a term pregnancy and a baby in the occiput posterior position in the second stage of labor
finding: Prophylactic manual rotation did not result in a reduction in the rate of operative delivery.
